bagPolicy.summary: Intuit Dome does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at the VIP West Garage, Standard East Garage, and Players' Garage. Parking fees vary by event, and garages open approximately four hours before showtime. Purchasing a parking pass in advance is recommended.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Intuit Dome's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Intuit Dome varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Additionally, Sensory Bags are available at the Answers Portal located by Section Main 6 on the main level concourse. Please visit the Intuit Dome Mobility Hub located on the first level of our Standard East Garage (3700 W Century Blvd, Inglewood, CA) for rideshare drop off and pickup.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Intuit Dome's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Intuit Dome. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Intuit Dome. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
